note: Cross-repo contract for the marketplace hire (web WP-37/WP-38, app WP-38). This file is duplicated byte-for-byte in work-address/web (api/src/test/fixture) and work-address/app (api/src/test/fixture); they are separate repositories, so each owns a copy. web asserts HireClient PRODUCES these bytes, this header and this signature; app asserts its MarketplaceHireDto re-serialises to exactly them and that the controller ACCEPTS them. The body is an accepted offer as the marketplace pushes it: rateHour is whole USDT an hour (0 for fixed-price work), weeklyLimit the hour cap the freelancer accepted (null when the offer set none), trackScreenshots and trackProcesses the monitoring those same terms disclosed - app applies all three to the project it opens rather than its own defaults. freelancerAddress is the fallback for a freelancer with no account there yet (null otherwise); text is the agreed scope. issuedAt (unix seconds) and nonce are the replay guard, as for the settlement push. The HMAC-SHA256 hex signature over the exact serialised bytes goes in the header named below, with the shared entitlement secret. Every key is always present, in this order, because app verifies the signature over its own re-serialisation of the parsed DTO. Change both copies in the same pull request or not at all.
